acceptedAnswer.text: The investment for a custom home addition in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex varies widely depending on factors such as the addition's size, complexity, selected finishes, and specific site conditions. Due to the highly customized nature of our work, providing a 'typical' range without understanding your specific project scope is not feasible. AKN Design Group focuses on customized solutions that enhance functionality, beauty, and long-term value. We provide upfront, transparent estimates after a thorough consultation to align with your vision and deliver exceptional craftsmanship.
